name: NGP transfer hook drains the pair reserve and syncs
summary: On every sell NGP's _update hook moved the treasury and reward fees out of the PancakeSwap pair's own NGP balance and called sync(), so each sell shrank the pair's NGP reserve and raised the price. Behind a flash loan the attacker repeated sells to inflate the price, then sold a large NGP position for almost all of the pair's USDT.
notes: Non-upgradeable token; the pair-draining sell hook was in the deployed code. Reset: the admin's setTradeState(true, true) (0xcbd4213f, block 61477442) set buyState and sellState (packed in slot 0x7), false from deployment and set only this once; before it every sell into the pair without a whitelisted party reverts "Sell not allowed", so the attacker's sells could not run, and this first opening of trading resets the age (rule 8). The admin's setFeeRates 0x866ac871 (block 61477070) shortly before cut treasury+reward from 70% to 35%, which only scales the loss.

The pair's USDT fell from 2,212,887.45 to 9.16 in the anchor; that net outflow is the LPs' loss. The NGP pulled from three holder accounts that approved the attacker contract minutes earlier is the attacker's own input.
